title: Add Alembic migrations and repository pattern to backend
description: Backend has no migration tool — schema changes are applied ad-hoc (SQLite recreated from scratch, PostgreSQL needs manual ALTERs). Routes also access SQLAlchemy ORM directly with no repository abstraction, so response mapping lives inline in route handlers. Priority 1: Add Alembic so schema changes are versioned and portable across SQLite/PostgreSQL. Priority 2 (optional): Introduce a repository layer to centralize ORM-to-DTO mapping.
